title: Typography Intro
slide_intent: Give designers a criterion for choosing type by the reader’s task. A product action and a moment of appetite call for different emphasis.
strategic_value: Instacart can use a type family with enough range to connect efficient shopping with the pleasure of what people eat.
demonstration: A single large dark statement on a pale field names efficiency and enjoyment as the two purposes of the family.
practical_value: Decide whether the reader needs to complete an action or linger over an idea before choosing the typographic treatment.
